question: Indian musician Ustad Alla Rakha Qureshi is associated with __________ musical instrument.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Alla Rakha Qureshi:-**

 
 
• **​He was an Indian tabla player who specialized in Hindustani classical music. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• He was a frequent accompanist of sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar and was largely responsible for introducing tabla to the Western audience.
 
• His son Zakir Hussain is a renowned tabla player in his own right.
 
• Alla Rakha was awarded numerous awards for his contributions to music, including:
 
 
• Padma Shri (1977)
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1982)
 
• Dadasaheb Phalke Award (1991)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
